title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Qualifying Stay and Admission Window Schedule
content:
Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage sets the same qualifying-stay figures in every one of its six tiers. The schedule below is the figure set the admissions and business office desks read when they test a skilled admission.

| Figure | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Qualifying minimum: consecutive midnights as a formally admitted hospital inpatient | 3 midnights |
| Midnights in outpatient observation status counted toward the qualifying stay | No (they do not count) |
| Qualifying admission window: calendar days after the qualifying hospital discharge date within which the center admission must occur | 30 days |
| SNF readmission window: calendar days after a covered center discharge within which a readmission needs no new qualifying hospital stay | 30 days |
| Interrupted-stay window: consecutive calendar days within which a return to the same center continues the same coverage episode | 3 days (return by 12:00 a.m. of the third day) |

The tiers covered are Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage, Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan A or B, Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan K, Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan L, Medicare Part A with Full-Coinsurance Medigap and Medicare Part A with QMB Medicaid Crossover; none of them departs from these figures, because the supplemental protection on file changes who shares the coinsurance, not the Medicare qualifying rules.

### Reading the figures

- The qualifying minimum is an integer count of midnights spent as a formally admitted inpatient; a hospital stay of 2 inpatient midnights plus observation midnights is still 2 for this purpose.
- The 30-day admission window and the 30-day readmission window are counted in calendar days.
- The 3-day interrupted-stay figure is the window that decides whether a return continues the open episode.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a resident with 4 inpatient midnights and 1 observation midnight before the hospital discharge has 4 qualifying midnights, which meets the minimum of 3 in any tier.
